description: This file implements secret management for Kubernetes kubelet, including interfaces and classes for secret retrieval, registration, caching, and watching mechanisms.

classes.name: simpleSecretManager
classes.description: Implements the Manager interface with simple API calls to Kubernetes API server.

classes.name: secretManager
classes.description: Implements secret management with caching and watch-based mechanisms.

methods.name: GetSecret
methods.description: Retrieves a secret by namespace and name.

methods.name: RegisterPod
methods.description: Registers all secrets from a given pod.

methods.name: UnregisterPod
methods.description: Unregisters secrets associated with a given pod.

methods.name: getSecretNames
methods.description: Extracts secret names referenced by a pod.

methods.name: NewSimpleSecretManager
methods.description: Creates a new simple secret manager instance.

methods.name: NewCachingSecretManager
methods.description: Creates a cache-based secret manager with TTL support.

methods.name: NewWatchingSecretManager
methods.description: Creates a watch-based secret manager with real-time updates.
